uncheckedSendable.rationale: Value wrapper delegates access to the thread-safe UserDefaults implementation and stores no mutable reference state.
All JSONDecoder access is serialized by the wrapper lock.
Process and pipe lifecycle state is protected by one NSLock; each async operation snapshots its dedicated file handle under that lock before use.
Collected output is protected by an internal lock.
Process lifecycle state is protected by an internal lock and single completion path.
File-handle callback admission and the active drain count are protected by one NSCondition before the coordinator crosses callback queues.
Cancellation state is synchronized by the token lock.
Testable in-memory credential storage is protected by the coordinator lock.
The coordinator is the serialization primitive for token mutations.
All mutable credential operations are serialized by the mutation coordinator.
Service dependencies are immutable and each operation uses isolated local state.
Mutable database access is delegated to its serialized database boundary.
Service configuration is immutable and request work is operation-local.
URLSession operation state is synchronized by its lock and single completion path.
The synchronous HTML LRU is shared by WebView renders; its cache and recency mutations are protected by one NSLock.
The decoded-vector cache is an independent synchronous hot-path boundary; values and recency are protected by one NSLock instead of actor suspension.
SQLite connection state remains synchronous for the reader store; every handle and statement operation is serialized by the database lock.
The SQLite prepared statement cache is used within the serial database lock boundary; all cache insertions, lookups, resets, and finalizations are coordinated by the parent database lock.
Value service stores immutable sendable command dependencies; filesystem objects remain operation-local.
Preview output buffers are protected by the collector lock.
Process lifecycle mutations are protected by the service lock.
Mutable repository-path cache access is serialized by the instance lock; immutable publishing dependencies conform to Sendable.
Launch config is immutable; UserDefaults and the injected Sendable bookmark/security-scope callbacks support moving blocking root resolution and probing off the main actor.
Wrapper exposes only documented thread-safe FileManager operations and has no mutable state.
JSONDecoder access is serialized by the wrapper lock.
JSONEncoder access is serialized by the wrapper lock.
SQLite access and mutable database state are confined to the database queue.
Commit sequencing state is protected by the coordinator lock.
Revision counters are protected by the state lock.
Test probe state is protected by its lock and is only used to assert cancellation.
Test transport observations are protected by the probe lock.
Test gate state is protected by its synchronization primitive.
Test recorder mutations are protected by its lock.
Test commit coordination state is protected by its lock and continuation handoff.
Journal generation state and the synchronous write path are serialized by the coordinator lock.
Index mutations are serialized by the static lock; instance dependencies are immutable and filesystem access uses the SendableFileManager boundary.
Mutable watcher sources are confined to its serial queue and lifecycle flags are protected by the state lock.
Test invocation state is protected by its NSLock while callbacks may cross task boundaries.
Test watcher observations and fulfillment state are protected by the state lock.
Test security-scope callback observations are stored behind one NSLock and exposed through atomic helpers.
The one-shot consumption flag is protected by its NSLock, so prepared-request use remains atomic when the Sendable value crosses task boundaries.
The recursive lock serializes storage-mode, session, generation, Keychain, and local-file mutations before the class crosses Sendable task boundaries.
The test callback's observed backup-exclusion paths are protected by one NSLock while callbacks and assertions may run across task boundaries.
The probe's invocation and main-thread flags are protected by one NSLock while background-save callbacks report to the test assertions.

forcedOperations.rationale: The test fixture is a fixed JSON-compatible dictionary and setup failure should abort the test immediately.
The integration-test tool-call arguments are deliberately constructed as a JSON-compatible fixture; serialization failure indicates invalid test setup and should abort immediately.
The integration-test response envelopes are fixed JSON-compatible fixtures; serialization failure indicates invalid test setup and should abort immediately.

optionalOperations.rationale: A failed attachment import already preserves its primary error; removing the newly created empty staging directory is best-effort cleanup only.
The screenshot harness writes diagnostic metadata only when explicitly enabled; capture failures are reported through the harness output path.
The screenshot harness writes a secondary diagnostic file and does not affect product data.
Disk thumbnail cache creation is optional; a cache miss remains safe and the source image is still available.
Updating cache recency metadata is optional and cannot invalidate the source image.
Optional feed discovery is a non-mutating enhancement; the UI keeps the current feed state when discovery fails.
Older RSS records may omit or contain an invalid optional date; decoding falls back to the record timestamp policy.
Directory fsync is a durability hint after the primary file operation; the caller still reports the primary write result.
The output handle is closed during temporary backup cleanup after the package operation has completed.
Health reporting treats unavailable storage metadata as an unknown size and continues with the remaining references.
OCR language discovery is advisory; unsupported language metadata causes the caller to use its supported default path.
On-device model asset preparation is optional background work and a missing model is reported through the embedding availability path.
A single unavailable local embedding is treated as a cache/model miss; database state is not mutated by this probe.
The import index is auxiliary metadata; a failed optional snapshot encoding does not alter imported content.
External-modification detection is conservative: an unreadable state is treated as changed and blocks automatic cleanup.
The non-throwing find command is a UI convenience wrapper; invalid query syntax produces no match rather than mutating content.
The non-throwing replace wrapper returns an unchanged editor mutation when the query is invalid; it does not persist a partial edit.
The non-throwing replace-all wrapper returns an unchanged editor mutation when validation fails.
SEO preview metadata is auxiliary output; invalid optional metadata is omitted rather than blocking the article.
Starter setup probes optional Git metadata and continues with an empty value when the repository is not yet initialized.
The boolean validation helper intentionally maps an invalid automation plan to false before execution.
Migration inventory validation treats an invalid candidate snapshot as unusable and continues searching for a valid source.
A release record without the required remote identity has no safe rollback action; returning nil hides only that unavailable action.
A release record without a review identity has no safe withdrawal action; returning nil hides only that unavailable action.
Persisted feed issue JSON is optional diagnostic metadata; malformed metadata does not invalidate the feed row.
Comparing a cached permission check is a conservative non-mutating probe; an invalid current profile cannot be treated as a verified match.
The legacy per-site credential is intentionally cleaned up separately; failure must not make the primary shared-key save/delete appear unsuccessful.
Retired feature archival is optional compatibility metadata; the primary workbench snapshot remains untouched when it cannot be encoded.
Unreadable recovery journals expose both outcomes to the user: quarantine success names the file, while failure explicitly says the original was kept.
Tool-choice decoding first probes the scalar mode form; a failed string decode intentionally falls through to the keyed function form.
After the shared credential is saved, removing the old origin-bound Keychain item is compatibility cleanup; failure must not make the primary save fail.
Invalid step arguments make the candidate automation plan unusable, so the parser returns no plan before any command can execute.
While the article index is incomplete, the read-only total-count query is advisory; a database failure keeps the UI on the safe zero-count fallback.
While the article index is incomplete, the read-only feed-count query is advisory; a database failure keeps the UI on the safe zero-count fallback.
A header lookup during incomplete database bootstrap is a non-mutating probe; failure returns nil so the article is treated as unavailable until a later refresh.
If agent-task capability resolution fails, the caller deliberately continues on the ordinary text-chat protocol without declaring tools or executing a plan.

optionalOperationRules.rationale: Tests use optional cleanup, cancellation, and fixture parsing so one failing teardown does not hide the assertion under test.
A malformed or unsupported pattern makes the parser unavailable; callers already use the empty/unsupported result path.
Optional decoding is used for compatibility, streamed payload variants, or persisted data migration.
Streaming response content is decoded by trying the supported variant shapes in order.
Streaming response content is decoded by trying the supported scalar shape before other variants.
The input is an untrusted response or persisted payload and invalid JSON follows the existing parse-failure branch.
Paste/import XML is optional input; malformed markup is rejected by the surrounding parser.
Rich-text or markdown conversion is best-effort parsing with a plain-text fallback.
Markdown presentation parsing is optional and the caller preserves the original text when it fails.
Import probing skips unreadable candidate files and continues scanning the remaining sources.
Recovery/cache payload reads are validated by the surrounding decoder or recovery path.
Bounded import reads are optional candidate input and the enclosing parser skips unreadable data.
User-provided or imported URL text is validated by treating malformed values as absent.
Filesystem metadata probes are advisory; the caller falls back to the safe unavailable state.
A failed metadata probe cannot establish a usable candidate and is handled as unavailable.
Directory enumeration is an optional discovery/cache probe; failure yields no candidates.
Symlink detection is a safety probe and a failed lookup is treated as not-a-link by the caller.
Optional asset-path probing skips paths that cannot be validated.
Network URL validation is a non-mutating availability check; invalid URLs are rejected by the caller.
Debounce/retry sleeps are intentionally cancellable and cancellation ends the pending task.
Cancellation probes intentionally stop optional background work without surfacing an operation error.
The target is an operation-local staging, cache, or cancellation artifact; the primary operation already owns the user-visible result.
The target is an operation-local staging, cache, or cancellation artifact; the primary operation already owns the user-visible result.
File-handle close is resource cleanup after the read/write result has already been determined.
The value is auxiliary metadata or a compatibility payload, not the primary save/publish transaction.
The value is an auxiliary compatibility or protocol payload and the enclosing path has a bounded fallback.
The browser/protocol response has a valid empty-object fallback when an optional value cannot be encoded.
Screenshot/demo data is an explicitly enabled diagnostic fixture and is outside the production save/publish path.
